resources.string: The su binary is gone — usually after a ROM update/flash or when the root solution (e.g. APatch) was removed.\n\nScene will run in Monitor mode: the device stays stock and nothing is tuned. Install root again and reboot to restore full functionality.
No root detected — Monitor mode. Tuning and app actions are disabled until root is back.
Root is back — tap to re-enable the Scene engine.
No root (su missing). Tuning was skipped and the engine was disabled. Install root, then reboot.
Root access denied. Tuning was skipped and the engine was disabled.
Tuning needs root — Monitor mode is active.
Root is not available (ROM updated / root removed) — this feature needs root.
Root is back — the Scene engine has been re-enabled.

Restores stock tuning, unfreezes every app Scene froze and removes all Scene modules/scripts — so uninstalling Scene leaves nothing behind. The automatic guard does the same if the app is removed without this step.
Undo every change Scene made outside the app (tuning, frozen apps, tweaks, modules, scripts)? After this the app can be uninstalled safely.
